instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT introduce new colors. STRICTLY use the defined dark navy, gold, and primary blue palette.
Do NOT introduce new fonts. STRICTLY use Barlow Condensed and Inter.
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for complex editorial layouts to allow for high customization rather than relying on strict rigid UI components.
Ensure 'Interviste' uses a bold quote-style with a thick gold left border.
Ensure 'Vetrina Foto/Video in vendita' correctly visualizes locked digital products with a blurred preview image until hovered.
Apply the class 'fsl-card' for general surfacing, and 'btn-gold' / 'btn-primary' for CTAs as predefined in the problem statement.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use generic placeholder text if you can use contextual wording.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds under text that rests over images. Always use hero-overlay or bg-black/50.
Ensure interactive elements have explicit hover/focus state overrides.
